plugin.name: Love With You
plugin.description: Romance layer: affection 0-100 and five relationship stages that shape how the character talks to you and what they call you. Becoming lovers takes a confession; anniversaries are remembered and the affection trend is charted. Shared across characters, or tracked per character.

rules.title: Relationship rules
rules.autoScoreNote: After each exchange, the plugin judges how much it changed affection. By default it uses local keywords. For better judgement, bind a model to this plugin's "好感判断" (affection judge) usage on N.E.K.O's Plugin API page. Only a one-line reason is kept, never the chat itself.
rules.autoScoreOffNote: When off, the character has to call a tool to change affection, which many models almost never do.
rules.autoNoBus: Chat messages are not readable right now. Make sure user plugins are enabled in N.E.K.O.
rules.autoIdle: Once you start chatting, this shows how many exchanges were judged.
rules.autoModeModel: Judged by the model you bound.
rules.autoModeFallback: The bound model gave no answer this time, so keywords were used.
rules.confessionNote: At 80 the relationship waits at "Almost" until you really confess to each other in chat. Existing lovers are not affected.
rules.proactiveConfession: Allow the character to confess first
rules.proactiveConfessionNote: Requires automatic judging and the confession gate. At 80 or above, the character may confess after a normal exchange and wait for explicit consent. Refusal or hesitation starts a 24-hour cooldown; 30 minutes without confirmation starts a 6-hour cooldown. Up to 3 attempts per relationship. Off by default.
rules.decayNote: After {grace} quiet days, affection drops {per} per day, never below the current stage, so the relationship never regresses from this.
rules.decayOnMessage: Counting starts today: after {grace} quiet days, -{per} per day, never below the current stage.
rules.gateOffMessage: Characters already at 80 become lovers right away. This cannot be undone.
settings.title: Characters & affection
settings.perCharacterNote: When off, all characters share one relationship. Switching carries the current affection value; existing shared and individual records keep their own confession, dates and history.
perChar.onMessage: The current character keeps the current affection value. Existing individual records retain their confession, dates and history. A new current-character record inherits the shared relationship; other new characters start at 0.
perChar.offMessage: Shared affection takes the current character's value. The shared relationship keeps its own confession, dates and history. All individual records are also kept.
adjust.title: Adjust affection
adjust.note: Manual changes ignore the daily limits; the stage follows the new value directly.
reset.title: Only zero affection?
reset.message: Set affection for {name} to 0. Confirmed romance, the together date and history remain, so the relationship can still show as partners who have grown distant. Other relationship records, gold and inventory are unchanged.
restart.title: Start this relationship over?
restart.message: Set affection for {name} to 0, clear romance confirmation, the confession and the together date, and end any active confession. Return to strangers. Keep the first-met date, history, naming preferences, gold and inventory. Other relationship records are unchanged.
restart.description: Clear affection, romance confirmation and the together date for one relationship. Keep history, first-met date, preferences and assets.
